meta.name: Bad Cop
meta.description: Twin brothers on the opposite sides of the law get caught in a complex web of deceit, loyalty and betrayal.

videos.title: Karan Ya Arjun
videos.overview: Petty thief Arjun accidentally witnesses a crime. Kazbe rules the underground from inside the prison. Police inspector Karan gets a tip-off about a dubious consignment.

videos.title: Pehchan Kaun
videos.overview: CIB officer Khan finds CCTV footage of Karan and learns his secret. A guilt-ridden Arjun leaves a letter for Devika. On his way out of the city, he gets attacked again.

videos.title: Chori Chupke
videos.overview: Khan suspects Karan is in touch with Arjun. On Arjun's first day at the police station, Devika questions him about the ambush. Chasing Raghav, they learn about Kazbe's consignment.

videos.title: Kazbe Ka Kazba
videos.overview: Kazbe is furious when cops seize his cargo and arrest Raghav. Arjun finds a briefcase in Karan's room. The murder probe heats up as Khan and Arjun hone in on a prime suspect.

videos.title: Pakda Pakdi
videos.overview: Arjun recruits Kiki to find the murder suspect, which puts her on Khan's radar. When Raghav returns to collect Kazbe's consignment, a surprise waits for him.

videos.title: Aamne Samne
videos.overview: Arjun confronts Khan about the bug in his house. Kiki is envious of Devika and Arjun's closeness. CIB cracks Mishra's hard drive, which reveals a shocking truth.

videos.title: Bad Cop
videos.overview: Arjun unearths those who are behind the poaching racket. Kiki gives him an ultimatum. Bala does the unthinkable and blames it on Arjun.

videos.title: Aakhiri Chull
videos.overview: In retaliation for Raghav's death, Kazbe abducts Rhea. As Khan arrives to arrest Arjun, Kiki does something unexpected.
